name: cover_trinity
prompt: Documentary photograph, Canon EOS R5, 35mm lens, late afternoon golden light. The United Trinity bronze statue of George Best, Denis Law and Bobby Charlton (sculptor Philip Jackson, unveiled 2008) standing on its dark granite plinth on Sir Matt Busby Way, seen from a low angle slightly off-centre, with the red-brick and glass East Stand of Old Trafford behind it. The large red capital letters MANCHESTER UNITED run across the top of the glass facade, exactly as on the real stadium. Match-day crowd in red shirts and scarves walking past, slightly blurred. Natural colour, realistic textures, no text other than the stadium lettering, no logos invented, no watermark, no illustration style.
